item.author: Stereogum (@stereogum.com)
item.description:
Gregg Alexander ended New Radicals after one album and became a successful behind-the-scenes songwriter.

He's penned hits like "Murder On The Dancefloor" and "The Game Of Love," but has rarely performed since the '90s.

Now New Radicals have quietly released their first new song in 28 years.

item.description: In Boston last night, Phish covered XTC’s “Melt The Guns” for the first time since April 29, 1987 – 2,051 shows prior – so it’s now the biggest bustout in Phish history. It shatters a record the band set just last week when they covered Foreigner’s “Cold As Ice” in NYC — after a gap of 1,469 shows.
